data.description:
Refuse a ticket at intake when its repository has no project checks entry and the source-control backend requires CI, instead of skipping the checks and denying the pull request at the promotion policy.

`config/local/checks.yaml.example` says a repository with no entry skips the checks gate with a warning. `run_project_checks` returns `ran=False` for such a repository and `_ci_and_repair` in `services/orchestration/temporal_workflows/draft_pull_request.py` records `CHECKS_SKIPPED` and reports `CI_PASSED` with `ci_status="skipped"`. The run then pays for the code-review, security-review, and acceptance gates. `config/policies/promotion.rego` requires `ci_status == "success"` whenever `ci_required` holds, and `services/integration/opa/mediator.py` sets `ci_required` for the GitHub backend, so the skip can never pass there. The run is denied as `ci_not_successful`, the same reason a failing check produces.

Execution `intake-55f8b3f6` for rebar ticket `ff34-7786-fef6-4252` on `archive-massgov-pfml` spent about thirteen minutes in planning, implementation, and three review gates before that denial, because the operator file had lost its `archive-massgov-pfml` entry.

When the backend requires CI and the resolved repository has no checks entry, hold the ticket at intake with the reason `checks_not_configured` and alert, so no model spend happens. Give the promotion policy a distinct `ci_skipped` reason for a skipped status so a run that reaches the policy another way reports the cause. Update the template comment to state that the GitHub backend refuses a repository without an entry. The local backend, which does not require CI, keeps the current skip.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Intake holds a ticket whose repository has no checks entry under the GitHub backend, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_reconciler.py -k holds_a_repository_without_checks_when_ci_is_required`
- [ ] Intake starts a ticket whose repository has no checks entry under the local backend, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_reconciler.py -k starts_a_repository_without_checks_when_ci_is_not_required`
- [ ] The promotion policy reports `ci_skipped` for a skipped status, proven by `pytest tests/integration/test_promotion_policy_rego.py -k skipped_ci_reports_ci_skipped`

## Testing
Run each acceptance criterion selector on its own. Run `PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/inv ci` before closing the ticket.
data.title: ADEVX-149: Refuse a ticket at intake when its repository has no checks entry and CI is required
